argv: const assert=require("node:assert/strict");const OM=require("C:/Users/Dave/.codex/skills/onetake/lib/motion.js");const size={W:1080,H:1920};const c=OM.camera(0,[],size);assert.deepEqual(c,{x:540,y:960,zoom:1,rot:0});const m=OM.view(c,size);assert.deepEqual(OM.project(m,540,960),[540,960]);assert.deepEqual(OM.projectBox(m,{x:72,y:180,w:864,h:1420,op:1}),{x:72,y:180,w:864,h:1420,op:1});assert.equal(OM.screenTravel(c,c,c,size),0);const keys=[{t:0,x:540,y:960,zoom:1},{t:1,x:540,y:900,zoom:1.2}];const before=OM.camera(.4,keys,size);OM.camera(.9,keys,size);OM.camera(.1,keys,size);assert.deepEqual(OM.camera(.4,keys,size),before);console.log("PASS original portrait camera center, identity projection, safe-area box, zero travel and deterministic evaluation");
